product.olivetti-m28-20c.summary: The 20 MB M28 configuration with a tape drive included.
product.olivetti-m28-20c.history: The Dutch brochure placed the M28/20C among the M28 professional configurations. The bundle included a 20 MB hard disk and a 20 MB tape drive.
product.olivetti-m28-20c.architecture: Tape provided a backup option. Olivetti’s configuration includes a 20 MB tape drive and a 12-inch monochrome monitor.
product.olivetti-m28-20c.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-m28-20c.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
